verified = []

    # paginate just in case
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    found = []
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_voice_messages(access_token=access_token, phone_number=pn, query=message_text, only_latest_per_contact=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
